title: Ask Kai Galosh about the Old Network

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: Ah, just what I needed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, just what I needed.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What is this Black Box?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What is this Black Box?

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: You really want to know? Asking about the Old Network is dangerous enough.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You really want to know? Asking about the Old Network is dangerous enough.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That was my part of the bargain.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That was my part of the bargain.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That was my part of the bargain.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That was my part of the bargain.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: And now comes mine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And now comes mine.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll keep my nose out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll keep my nose out.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: Smart.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Smart.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: Before the sprawl of The Nets as we know them, there was once a free macro-network.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Before the sprawl of The Nets as we know them, there was once a free macro-network.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Free? What does that mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Free? What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: Controlled by no one. No Corp oversight. Pure user-driven data.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Controlled by no one. No Corp oversight. Pure user-driven data.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: It was a patchwork of super computers, grey terminals and trash... but it worked. Too well. Oversight was impossible.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It was a patchwork of super computers, grey terminals and trash... but it worked. Too well. Oversight was impossible.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes! Anarchy!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes! Anarchy!

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: I wouldn't call it anarchy. But there were places that were hidden from corp supervision.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wouldn't call it anarchy. But there were places that were hidden from corp supervision.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: A naive take on the situation. But yes, it was dangerous.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A naive take on the situation. But yes, it was dangerous.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: When The Nets expanded and conglomerated, the Old Network was deprecated.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When The Nets expanded and conglomerated, the Old Network was deprecated.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So it's dead and gone?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So it's dead and gone?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Good!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good!

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: That's what LifeCorp thinks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's what LifeCorp thinks.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: And believe me, you don't want to change their mind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And believe me, you don't want to change their mind.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why is that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why is that?

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: Thaddeus left a hidden data stream port in Ava. One that even she didn't know about. He told me that one day someone would ask about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thaddeus left a hidden data stream port in Ava. One that even she didn't know about. He told me that one day someone would ask about it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wait! You knew that all along?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait! You knew that all along?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Wait! You knew that all along?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Wait! You knew that all along?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thaddeus told you about it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thaddeus told you about it?

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: He also told me that when you came to me, I should tell you about secure access throughout the city. But you didn't come to me, yet.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He also told me that when you came to me, I should tell you about secure access throughout the city. But you didn't come to me, yet.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: We talked about data networks a lot. He respected my security expertise.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We talked about data networks a lot. He respected my security expertise.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And why did you want the Black Box?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And why did you want the Black Box?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And why did you want the Black Box?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And why did you want the Black Box?

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: Well, I heard you were a good fisherman, so I seized the opportunity.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I heard you were a good fisherman, so I seized the opportunity.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And if I hadn't brought it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And if I hadn't brought it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And if I hadn't brought it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And if I hadn't brought it?

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: I would have told you anyway. Eventually. I promised Thaddeus, but I couldn't miss an opportunity for a LITTLE extortion.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I would have told you anyway. Eventually. I promised Thaddeus, but I couldn't miss an opportunity for a LITTLE extortion.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: I opened the secret port in Ava's system. She now has access to everything else you need to know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I opened the secret port in Ava's system. She now has access to everything else you need to know.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: But tread lightly in the Old Network. It doesn't like strangers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But tread lightly in the Old Network. It doesn't like strangers.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: You must love this city.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You must love this city.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: As for the Old Network:

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As for the Old Network:

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Without the corps it must have been dangerous anarchy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Without the corps it must have been dangerous anarchy.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Without the corps it must have been dangerous anarchy.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Without the corps it must have been dangerous anarchy.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Macro?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Macro?

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: It was everywhere.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It was everywhere.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I wouldn't want to.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wouldn't want to.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm just a beginner.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm just a beginner.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: Yet you found the black box.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yet you found the black box.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I feel... different. Like another part of my brain just woke up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I feel... different. Like another part of my brain just woke up.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You don't have a real brain.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don't have a real brain.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You don't have a real brain.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You don't have a real brain.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You heard Kai, tread lightly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You heard Kai, tread lightly.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Give me a moment to process.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Give me a moment to process.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: But... now it feels like I really have one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But... now it feels like I really have one.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I love danger!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I love danger!
